about.en: Pheasant Network is an intent-based cross-chain protocol and AI-assisted DeFi app that lets users and agents state an outcome and have the network carry out the on-chain steps across chains. PNT is its ERC-20 token 0x02d54e48ea4dd76a408a7175d466bb8f578c0e93 on Ethereum; it is unrelated to pNetwork, whose token also uses the PNT ticker.
